prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective moving through a dimly lit, foggy outdoor setting at night, capturing the serene yet eerie atmosphere of Fushimi Inari Taisha in Kyoto, Japan. The camera slowly pans across the area, revealing an old wooden structure partially obscured by dense foliage and mist. As the viewer progresses, the path leads towards a prominent red torii gate standing tall amidst the trees, its vibrant color contrasting sharply with the muted tones of the surrounding environment. The camera continues forward, passing under the torii gate and entering a tunnel-like passage lined with more torii gates, each illuminated by soft, warm lanterns that cast a gentle glow on the stone pathway. The camera angle shifts slightly as it moves deeper into the tunnel, highlighting the intricate details of the wooden structures and the ambient light reflecting off the wet ground. The scene transitions smoothly from the open forested area to the enclosed passageway, maintaining a steady pace and providing a continuous view of the tranquil, empty shrine grounds enveloped in the cool, misty night air. The overall ambiance is one of quiet solitude, with the subtle interplay of light and shadow enhancing the mystical quality of the location.
